t: The Wago 770‑099/K000‑0007 is a pluggable installation connector designed for reliable power and signal distribution in professional electrical applications. Featuring Cage Clamp spring pressure connection technology, this connector enables fast, secure wiring without the need for screw connections, significantly reducing installation time and the risk of wiring errors. Rated for electrical currents up to 25A, it is ideal for general mains applications, including lighting circuits and power distribution systems. Its durable construction and secure contact design make it well suited for high‑power loads, delivering consistent performance even in demanding industrial environments. Part of Wago’s 770 series, this plug & socket solution ensures long‑term reliability while supporting efficient, error‑free installation, making it a preferred choice for lighting, power and HVAC systems.
b: 25A Rated Current Capacity for High‑Load Applications
Suitable for Lighting Circuits & Power Distribution Systems
High Contact Reliability for Long‑Term Operational Stability
